edges.reason: Constructor reads _rTotal to initialize the caller reflection balance.
Constructor uses _msgSender() for initial allocation and ownership.
Constructor assigns the Uniswap V2 router.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair.
Constructor marks owner and contract as fee exempt.
Constructor calls owner() to populate the fee exemption mapping.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for spender allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
approve calls _approve to persist the allowance.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the increased value.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decreased value.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to gauge contract holdings.
_transfer stores the contract token balance in a local variable.
_transfer compares contract balance against the swap threshold.
_transfer checks the inSwapAndLiquify guard before swapping.
_transfer checks the sender is not the Uniswap pair to avoid circular swaps.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify which performs external calls before the token move completes.
The Uniswap pair can call back into the token transfer path during swaps.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee at the end of the transfer.
_tokenTransfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit for non-exempt accounts.
_tokenTransfer reads _burnFee to compute the burn amount.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded status of both parties.
_tokenTransfer sends a funding piece to charityAddress.
_tokenTransfer sends a funding piece to communityAddress.
_tokenTransfer sends a funding piece to DevWallet.
swapAndLiquify computes the half local variable.
swapAndLiquify computes the otherHalf local variable.
swapAndLiquify computes the newBalance local variable from contract ETH.

swapAndLiquify performs an external swap via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify adds liquidity via an external router call.
swapAndLiquify interacts with the Uniswap pair which can call back into the token.
swapTokensForEth uses the stored Uniswap router.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap operation.
addLiquidity uses the stored Uniswap router.
addLiquidity approves the router before adding liquidity.
addLiquidity passes owner() as the liquidity recipient.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the deadline.
addLiquidity executes the external payable addLiquidityETH operation.
_takeLiquidity calls _getRate to convert tokens to reflections.
_takeLiquidity credits _tOwned of the contract when excluded.
removeAllFee zeroes _taxFee with no access restriction.
removeAllFee zeroes _liquidityFee with no access restriction.
removeAllFee zeroes _burnFee with no access restriction.
removeAllFee zeroes _fundingFee with no access restriction.
removeAllFee performs an unrestricted global fee reset unsafe operation.
restoreAllFee resets _taxFee with no access restriction.
restoreAllFee resets _liquidityFee with no access restriction.
restoreAllFee resets _burnFee with no access restriction.
restoreAllFee resets _fundingFee with no access restriction.
restoreAllFee performs an unrestricted fee restore unsafe operation.
deliver uses _msgSender() as the reflection payer.
excludeFromReward calls tokenFromReflection to snapshot balances.
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array.
tokenFromReflection stores the rate in the currentRate local.
setMaxTxPercent reads _tTotal for the percentage calculation.
lock clears _owner to lock the contract.
lock stores the previous owner in _previousOwner.
lock sets _lockTime using now, a timestamp dependency.
lock reads block.timestamp via now to compute the unlock time.
unlock reads _lockTime for the time check.
unlock uses now (block.timestamp) in the lock expiry require.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
receive accepts ETH from the router during swaps while the swap guard is set.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter used only by _transfer for balance checks and updates.
to is a parameter used only by _transfer to credit the recipient.
amount is a parameter consumed by _transfer to size the token move.
contractTokenBalance only feeds the split performed inside swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is the sole input of the external router swap.
tokenAmount is the token side input of the liquidity addition.
ethAmount is the ETH value forwarded to addLiquidityETH.
maxTxPercent updates the _maxTxAmount state inside the setter.
time is added to now to set _lockTime in the lock function.
newOwner becomes the new _owner during ownership transfer.
account is written into _isExcludedFromFee by the setter.
half is an intermediate split value local to swapAndLiquify.
otherHalf is an intermediate split value local to swapAndLiquify.
newBalance is the ETH measured from the swap and forwarded to the external liquidity call.
contractTokenBalance is a local used to decide whether to trigger swapAndLiquify.
